hints: You want to stop at the halfway point without knowing the length. What could you run alongside the walk that tells you when half of it is done?
A second walker moving twice as fast. When the fast one reaches the end, the slow one is at the middle.
Step the fast walker two links at a time and the slow one a single link; return the slow one once the fast one can go no further.
The loop condition decides which middle you land on for an even chain: continue while `fast` and `fast.next` both exist, and you land on the second.
